lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: predicting the effect of a rigid motion on a figure
lessonRef.title: Transfer challenge: predicting the effect of a rigid motion on a figure

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: The example is from a different context than the problems below.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A rigid motion is a transformation that …
choices: preserves shape but may change size
maps every figure to a similar figure
preserves area but may change side lengths

items.prompt: In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding sides and the pair of included angles are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
Two triangles share two pairs of congruent sides and a pair of congruent angles that are not between those sides. Why does this fail to prove congruence?
choices: Two sides are never enough information under any circumstances.
The triangles are congruent, but the criterion is simply named differently.
The unknown side can close the triangle in two different ways, producing one acute and one obtuse triangle from the same measurements.
The angle must be a right angle for any criterion to apply.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 71° and ∠B = 73°. Find ∠F.
Two figures are congruent if and only if …
choices: there is a sequence of rigid motions taking one exactly onto the other
they can be scaled to match

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: These are meant to be hard. Show the reasoning even if you do not finish.

items.prompt: In two triangles, the hypotenuses and one pair of legs of two right triangles are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 39° and ∠B = 45°. Find ∠F.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 78° and ∠B = 27°. Find ∠F.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
